label: VERIFIED
extraction: Claude Code Agent Hooks: Type 'agent' spawns subagent that can use tools like Read, Grep, Glob to verify conditions before returning decision. Agent hooks are experimental and may change. Used for complex verification requiring file exploration. Subagent has access to Read, Grep, Glob tools. Returns decision as JSON. Complements prompt hooks (LLM evaluation) and command hooks (deterministic rules). Configured in settings.json hooks block.
